rule: Result = 1 if (Gender==0 and Hemoglobin<12.0) or (Gender==1 and Hemoglobin<13.5), else 0
limitation: The binary target is an exact sex-specific hemoglobin threshold. A model that receives hemoglobin is reproducing that rule. The file has no pregnancy indicator, no patient identifier, and no RBC column. Duplicate rows are exact copies, not verified repeat visits.
